_edition: OMB 1205-0508, expiration date 04/30/2021 PRINTED ON THE BLANK at data/reference/forms/eta-9141-2021.pdf - 4 pages, 130 AcroForm fields. The sibling map eta-9141.map.json covers the older blank (expiration 05/31/2019, 79 fields). Every name in this map was read out of THIS PDF with pypdf get_fields(); nothing was typed from the picture.
_edition_currency: 04/30/2021 is the expiration date the blank itself prints. Ellis does NOT claim it is DOL's current edition - it is only the newer of the two blanks on this server. The prevailing wage determination is requested in FLAG (flag.dol.gov), where DOL serves its own current form; confirm the current edition at the source URL above before relying on any printout.
_note: PREP/REVIEW COPY ONLY. Format matches eta-9035.map.json and the 2019 sibling: 'fields' maps the PDF's own AcroForm field name -> Ellis answer key (names are the printed questions, double spaces and all); 'checkboxes' maps an Ellis answer key -> {answer value: PDF field name}; 'checkbox_states' records the EXACT on-state of every field named there, read from that widget's own /AP /N; 'radio_groups' covers the questions asked as ONE /Btn with one state per option. THE TRAP: E.b question 2 answers YES with '/0' while question 3 answers NO with '/0', and question 4 answers NO with '/2' - a generic '/On' tick would silently answer the wrong thing, so every state here was read from the widget and the yes/no side was fixed by the widget's own x position (the printed order is 'Yes  No').
_diff_from_2019: This blank is a STRICT SUPERSET of the 2019 one: all 79 of that edition's fields exist here under byte-identical names, plus 51 more. Not one of the 51 is a new employer question. 22 are Section F (Prevailing Wage Determination, headed FOR OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT USE ONLY) on page 4 - on the 2019 blank that page carried no widget at all, so nothing could land there BY CONSTRUCTION; here it can, and only '_human_only' stops it. 12 are the DOL-use running footer's data slots. 17 are static printed text the form generator turned into widgets, including three that sit ON TOP of the printed E.b question lines. The employer-side wage questions this edition was expected to add do not exist: the piece-rate 'wage offer requirements' box is Section F item 5a, inside the government block, under DOL's own 'Per:' question. Neither edition has an employer 'wage offered' field or an employment begin/end date field - those live on the ETA-9035 (LCA).

_human_only_note: The hard never-write list, and why each name is on it. This blank carries NO signature or date-of-signature widget: the PWD request is signed and submitted by a human inside FLAG, so there is nothing here for a machine to sign. What the list does hold is (a) '_government_use_only' - Section F, which is DOL's ANSWER to this request (their PW tracking number, the date they received it, their SOC code and title, the prevailing wage, the OES wage level, the per- unit, the wage source, their notes, the determination and expiration dates) plus the DOL-use footer's tracking/status/validity slots; and (b) '_static_page_text' - printed page furniture the form generator turned into fields, where a write would print over the government's own page. Ellis's computed wage level travels in the payload as a suggestion and never onto the form.
